notes.title: Let's School One Year Anniversary! 'Claim' Your Headmaster Reward In-Game!
notes.content:
Hello headmasters,

I'm Lanka, the director of the Let's School dev team. It's been officially a year since the release of Let's School on PC, and to celebrate this milestone, an anniversary monument with special perks will be gifted to all players in-game. Come and check out in-game right now in today's update!

Patch Notes

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed an issue that will cause students to get stuck
- Fixed an issue when placing furniture towards the wall, the furniture will be in the air
- Fixed an issue with excessively long module names will went over the UI limit
- Optimized construction efficiency
- Fixed an issue with the mod description text went over the limit and caused players unable to proceed
- Fixed a model issue with the wooden pillar
- Fixed an issue with certain carpets cannot be placed beneath the furniture
- Fixed an issue with furniture creation tool still has untranslated text
- Fixed an issue with the same model being used for two Magical Castles DLC constructible items
- Fixed an issue with students in the dormitory having a chance to not attend school
- Fixed an issue with the empty image slot being displayed when trying to delete modules 
- Fixed a crashing issue when selecting uniforms
- Added additional student uniforms icons
- Fixed an issue with the uniform editing panel cannot remove hats
- Fixed an issue with the uniform editing panel to make sure it displays correct content consistently
- Fixed an issue with the security guard might occasionally not react to the incidents
- Fixed an issue with players unable to upload music to the music club
- Fixed an issue with character attributes check
- Fixed an error when loading the custom mod wall 
- Fixed an issue with the modding tool text went over the UI limit 
- Fixed an issue with custom mod NPCs changing outfits when working
- Fixed an issue the teaching policy getting paused, even if all seats are being perfectly placed

New Additions:

- Added anniversary monument
- Added one-year anniversary student uniform
- Added 'tag' feature to make it easier for players to navigate on Steam


It's been a long journey over the past year, with significant improvements to the title through various major updates. From adding staff professions, the club gameplay, to the official Steam workshop support, as well as the full release on the console platforms. The team learned a lot over the past year and received all the feedback, encouragement, and support by our dear headmasters. 

As an indie team, we're so happy to have witnessed the game coming along. I remember back in 2016, Let's School was merely an immature idea in my head. Fast forward to 2024, we now have a growing community and countless headmasters who have enjoyed our game. There's really no word to describe my feelings, and I just want to take a little moment to share a little birth story of Let's School.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/53f5c88b571c94d972cb6331170e9515f7929ce2.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/659cf4ca6ed551059427cdf2f0e443bbe6582d28.gif

The initial idea of Let's School was inspired by a Japanese anime called 'Nichijou' (anyone seen it before?). I was blown away by the general vibes and the emotional values of that series, it then became a dream of mine to create a cozy, adorable simulation game that centered around school life. 

At the time, I was only a concept artist who just got into the video game industry, filled with passion and confusion for the future. Luckily, the team I was part of and the indie game community online helped me get through all the essential skills needed for game development. Then I started to spend my spare time creating some simple demos, from crafting systems to the simulation of characters, building experiences step by step along the way.

Then the busy work started to hit me hard, to the point where I even wanted to give up. Later on, I became a game designer, only to find out that the success of a video game is not just about visuals, but also relies on great gameplay and game mechanics. That totally refreshed my mind, which I then started to dive deep into the gameplay design and tried to understand the video games on the market through various perspectives. It took me a long while to discover that the game is not just about visual impressions. 

A while after that, I started to be in charge of project management for a mobile game. Project management taught me to think game development as running and structuring an organization.
For instance, workflow and development pipeline are needed for game dev, plus the coordination between different teams, balance relationships etc. I then took the inspiration into the game and built mechanics so that players could oversee structures and manage organizations, which is exactly where those management panels were born. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/c9dd455a0ceb37be22e4efa668209640d704acaa.png

Fast forward a few years later, I finally got the opportunity to turn my ideology into a real project, thanks to the massive support from Pathea Games! I started to create our team from scratch using the demo I made, with a lot more folks joining the team. 

However, the game development is never easy, with technical and design problems stuck in our way all the time. We've had our ups and downs, gone through challenges and difficulties, But the team has all made it through in two and half years and release the game successfully which was a massive achievement on its own.

This is the behind the scenes of Let's School. It's been a very long journey, with smiles and tears, but your continuous love and support made it worthwhile and we truly appreciate it.

After months of development, Let's School is now available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation and Xbox platforms!

notes.title: Behind The School #2 - Performance Update
notes.content:
Hello headmasters!

We hope you're having a great time with the Spring Sale and the March update! As mentioned in the March update patch notes, the team has managed to optimize the performance of the game, especially for headmasters in their late-game campaign. Today in this episode of Behind The School, we would like to run you through some of the detailed optimizations and how we made it happen. 

Increased Department Map Efficiency

Firstly, we found that players are experiencing an increasingly complicated department structure, especially in many mid to late-game scenarios. The large amount of sub-branches in the department map could potentially result in lags and longer loading times.

To tackle this problem, the team has taken the time to simplify the sub-branches while optimizing the algorithms behind the creation of these sub-branches. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/1649e7cb71bc514f2b652f80e3be5074b55dc0ed.png

Thanks to this adjustment, headmasters can now enjoy a smoother late-game experience, as long as a quicker entry to the department map panel.

Furniture Rendering Optimization Within The Building Structure

In the past builds, a smooth gameplay experience was largely challenged by the heavy use of glass, structures of various colors, as well as colored roofs by building enthusiasts. This is because the system backends did create a lot of objects that are semi-transparent or in various shapes, which resulted in a much longer rendering time.

However, in the latest update, the efficiency has been largely improved by consolidating the furniture rendering batches through Instantiated Rendering (GPUInstance). We suggest all headmasters to return to your school and see if the experience is more smoother than it was before!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/76487e29612e3af8a32190d2d5e377036a02e16b.png

As we can see, the setpasscall went from 1900+ to 600+ now
And CPU main thread overhead reduced from 40ms+ down to 20ms+

Increased SSAO (Ambient Occlusion) Efficiency

Ambient Occlusion is crucial for achieving a realistic visuals. However, such feature usually comes with an additional rendering cost.

Upon evaluating all possible options, the team has decided to skip the NormalPass rendering while switching to the AO algorithm for a faster processing speed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/c6ee55b9ad444c62684ad6eb9f886e10ebdb4fd2.png

At the end, we would like to thank all headmasters for your continuous support on this game!

To be honest, game optimization is a challenging task and the team is taking all steps possible to improve the player experience while developing new content for this game. 
Please stay passionate and patient for Let’s School as we move forward, with exciting news to unveil in the coming months!

And as we aim to increase our presence within the community this year, please make sure to follow our official subreddit for exclusive events & AMA coming up soon!

We're so happy to see you all enjoyed the new club gameplay and provided valuable feedback since the introduction of the school club system back in the Lunar New Year this February. 

And after reading through all of it, we've decided to set the tone for the March update to be around the club system optimizations, in hopes of providing a better experience to all our headmasters.

We would like to explain the core changes coming into the club feature, in the form of a dev update called the 'Behind The School'. It's a dev-focused blog post series that highlights the Let's School game development, with insightful stories and a place to express our thoughts to all the headmasters who care about this project.

And don't forget to follow our Reddit community now, where you can expect regular dev updates, monthly AMA sessions, exciting community events from us coming very soon!

1. Simplified Student Growth Within The Club Structure

One of the biggest changes we made this time is associated with the club strength. Since the initial update, we've found that many players were confused by the Guard, Vertical Jump, Ball Control stats and their relationships with the club strength in the basketball club.

To address this problem, we've decided to simplify the training process by removing these exclusive stats completely out of the basketball club (and other future clubs), so that headmasters are now able to link student training directly with the club strength.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/fe2033f14e7ea2da8e2c6adf723bf730e997da28.png
2. Detailed Breakdown On Club Talent

Many players have also been commenting on the unclear club talent stats, without knowing how it was calculated. Therefore, a detailed breakdown of the club talent stat has been added in this update.

The club talent stat is one of the main factors that effect student's speed of growth during club activities. Determined by a variety of attributes, the club talent stat can be increased by improving student stats in related fields.

For example: Basketball Talent = Physique + Sports Knowledge Point + Height

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/b55ae70edcafd51b894f1982bde647852b297694.png
3. Adding Team Position Bonus

To emphasize the importance of various team positions in the field and provide a more diverse gameplay strategy, a new position bonus is now added on top of the student's existing club strength when the student meets certain criteria. 

With this change, it is now crucial to allocate students in their appropriate positions for an extra layer of competitive advantage. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/cd4f1b188e22d82d9268433ac74ce1ffdeadbb77.png

Student Aptitude: To make it more clear and direct, the 'Student Aptitude' display are now optimized with breakdowns of each related sources

The past year has been both challenging and fulfilling for Let’s School. Thanks to the continuous support and valuable feedback from y'all, Let’s School has been growing steadily, with a 92% Steam positive review rate up to date! And we’re finally getting our first major update for 2024 ready to celebrate the upcoming Lunar New Year!  This time, we’re not only welcoming new map and gameplay features, but also heaps of optimizations to polish the game up even more. Let’s dive in and have a glimpse!

First up is the new map - Snow Cotton Town! It’s a snowy map that will bring you to the cozy winter and allow you to explore a brand-new European architectural design. In addition to the refreshing surroundings, it would certainly be a challenge for headmasters to warm up the campus and cope with the freezing cold weather.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/4862431dd384f205606d610b22ef5791c159b372.jpg
Moreover, the long-waited club system is finally here! We’ve introduced new furniture, along with a fresh set of entertaining gameplay. With the club feature, you’ll now be able to act as a basketball coach, develop young talents, set up formations for the match, and battle with other rival schools in community competitions to become the ultimate sports institution. Or you could turn into a music wizard, arranging tunes and stepping onto the stage of your dreams. It's up to the headmasters to discover all the little details coming into the club system, and as always, we hope you can share your thoughts with us so we can continue to make more fun clubs in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/0573028e76c6415163746dfe2bd3a343fdaccb1e.jpg

Multiple Positions Settings
Firstly, we've introduced a staff system based on suggestions from many players. In the previous version, some players found it odd that teachers were taking on roles as security guards, chefs, and doctors. In this new version, we've addressed this concern by allowing everyone to have distinct roles.
Visit the "Recruit" tab to hire staff for specific positions.
Each role comes with unique ability values that directly impact their job performance. Insufficient medical skills might worsen a person's condition, and inadequate culinary skills could lead to unappetizing dishes. By the way, you can also customize job titles. We're always eager to hear your feedback to further enhance the game.

Enhanced Earthquake Mechanism
Previously, the game only featured fires and lacked "challenges." In the new version, we've significantly improved and introduced the earthquake mechanism.
During an earthquake, it's crucial to promptly assist frightened students to prevent injuries. Conducting earthquake drills can reduce students' anxiety.
Afterward, there's the post-disaster rebuilding phase. To minimize damage, remember to upgrade the foundation early.

Mid-Autumn Festival Event and Furniture Sets
This being the Chinese Mid-Autumn version, we couldn't skip a festive event. When autumn arrives in the game, it triggers special tasks, unlocking a series of Mid-Autumn Festival outfits. Additionally, the store will offer a selection of mooncake products.

notes.title: Let's build your ideal school!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/bed8c9f5f99cb159f0600338ae86e8bb612c66ca.png

Hello, Headmasters! 

Let's School will be officially released on July 27th. Thank you all for playing the free demo and giving us positive feedback and suggestions!

We believe that lots of players are interested in the building modules in the Architect mode and may have unique insights into school construction. Clearly, the building feature is an essential gameplay element in Let's School, and it runs throughout the entire game process.

Let's take a look at some schools that our players have built. We firmly believe that every individual possesses brilliance and creativity!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/5982e2a5f09aca3e6da4b80289738d1c9a6ac3a1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/a8004e2c5690e497932b8bd0b71efe49b537c77b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/5ab55eac16fdd1540a3dfaeea5f66e55572856fc.jpg

Decorations

Regarding decorations of the free-building gameplay, the current version's decoration items are still lacking. Therefore, we continue to add more items to beautify the school, especially the number of roofs and their customizable properties.

Players who have played the new demo should know that you can use different roof styles to create almost any structure you want. Additionally, you can modify the materials, such as colors and the color of the side walls.

Furthermore, we have added some building styles that will appear in later stages of the game, such as glass curtain walls that resemble floor-to-ceiling windows in modern architecture. They allow Headmasters to give their schools a more fashionable and modernized look in the latter stages of the game.

Then there are other decorations, such as our custom blocks. These are basic-shaped blocks that Headmasters can freely use to modify colors and create any shape. This game feature is a bit similar to "Minecraft," which should give a similar feel for building enthusiasts.

Some players mentioned that there were very few lighting fixtures in the game. So we have added dozens of lighting fixtures that will be available in the early, middle, and late stages of the game. There are also various types of streetlights. Lighting can be extensively installed in the game, and we have implemented a series of effects such as color changes and range adjustments. This way, in the later stages of the game, you can create a more aesthetically pleasing atmosphere during the nighttime.

Design Styles

Regarding architectural styles - Currently, we have two styles, and each style has its own windows and wall features. In addition to that, some small parts are also customized for one of the two styles.

Gameplay

Regarding user experience - We have considered that some players may not have encountered similar games before, and they may feel confused or uncertain about various construction requirements in building mode.

For example, we found that building a classroom requires placing a blackboard, a podium, and desks and chairs. This process actually puzzled some players. Some Headmasters are not sure how to proceed at first. Don't worry, we will provide a more comprehensive tutorial guide. If you still can't find the corresponding button, we will make it automatically switch to show you what objects you still need. Although there is already a switching function now, it is not particularly refined. 

Some Headmasters have given feedback that they still don't know which conditions haven't been met. So next, we will further highlight those necessary conditions and indicate exactly what conditions need to be met. Additionally, clicking on those conditions will also display corresponding solutions. This way, even players who have never played this type of game before can get a good start.

Special Buildings

Regarding special building gameplay - In the game, you can construct hollowed-out buildings, which adds diversity to the appearance. As for roads, we are currently not able to create them due to some technical difficulties. We will make roads later, maybe in an update after the game is released. We might even add certain functions to the roads, such as speeding up when walking on certain paths.
The current trial version has already included elevators and underpasses, which can help Headmasters expand their schools on a larger scale. To put it simply, elevators and underpasses are like teleporters between different levels and flat spaces. If you build an underground passage from the school gate and place an exit far away, a person can quickly travel from the school gate to that distant location. It feels quite fun, let us know if you noticed the change.

Wonders

You can buy as many plots as possible. In the later stages of the game, if you want to build wonders, they will require a lot of land. As shown in the picture, these are our four major wonder venues: the Science Museum, the Sports Arena, the Museum, and the Art Gallery.

The construction processes for these wonders will be gradually added so that you can better enjoy this kind of excitement. Wonders are built in stages, and as the school level increases, you will continuously unlock them. There are a total of eight wonders (four primary and four advanced), each corresponding to a specific field of study: humanities, science, art, and sports.Additionally, there are some statues that players can create as well in the school.

Thank you, Headmasters, for reading this far. We hope that the Building Enthusiasts can fully enjoy the construction process in Let's School while players who may not be experienced at building won't feel overwhelmed. We welcome everyone to share the schools you have built in the comments section or to our community on Discord! 

If you have any questions, please leave us a message. Oh, and if you like Let's School, don't forget to add it to your Steam wishlist~

notes.content:
Howdy principals! ;) This is the first Dev Update since the Steam page was available. Your support and encouragement are the biggest motivation for the development of Let's School! 🎅

BTW, you can wishlist now on Steam if you stay tuned for Let's School.ːcozyrealmroyaleː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1937500/Lets_School/

✨We expect to be offering a free demo for testing soon, as we are eager to know what principals think of it and improve our game!
I am figuring out the exact time. When is it appropriate for you to take charge of the school?

We have been keeping an eye on everyone's comments, and many friends ask if the school can build multistory construction.
The answer is that you can build multistory construction. You can also find open-air rooftops on the upper floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/e8e6b7c024a80387a72d9c7c87ff4efab3d43ef9.jpg

❄️Look! It would be great if you could do something with this big area. As I said before, students can even swing on the roof but take it easy, and there is no way they will fall out. XD

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281844/0281226eb8e753c7de56f17964abbf7703d371db.png

It also includes the playground. Is it cool if the playground builds on the roof? Some sports competitions can hold on the playground. I have already shown some sports clubs to principals who pay attention to us. The sports meeting and traditional morning exercises will carry out on the playground.

BTW, do you think it's fun to farm on the roof? What about growing fresh vegetables for the canteen on the rooftop or having a farming club where students can pick research samples here? We will consider adding the ideal to future DLC if enough people like it. (We have got much development going on right now.)

🎄🎄It is Christmas, guys! Happy Christmas day! There are also some funny festivals in Let's School, such as Christmas day and Chinese New Year coming up! What can we do during the festival? Please leave your comments to let me know.
